leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

u```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

substrate:

  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  jwt:

  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

a```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

p```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

b```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

r```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

harnessGateway:

substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

s```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

t```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

w```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

e```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

 ```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

e```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in

  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

n```yaml
harnessGateway:

substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

s```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

b```yaml
harnessGateway:

substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

a```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

=```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:

    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

l```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

 ```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  ca:

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

 ```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

r```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  ca:

  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

 ```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

 ```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

T```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

a```yaml
harnessGateway:

substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

e```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

l```yaml
harnessGateway:
  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).

  enabled: true          # actors reach their model only through it
substrate:
  enabled: true
  default: true          # runs that name no backend go to Substrate
  allowPlaintextGatewayHop: true       # see "What is not supported yet"
  runnerImage: ghcr.io/sympozium-ai/sympozium/agent-runner@sha256:…
  controlAPI:
    endpoint: api.ate-system.svc:443
    tokenAudience: api.ate-system.svc
  jwt:
    issuer: https://idp.ate-system.svc
  ca:
    configMap: substrate-ca            # the CA of Substrate's API and issuer, key ca.crt
```

The chart refuses to render without a CA and a digest-pinned runner image:
Substrate snapshots the image once per namespace, so a tag that moves would
leave runs on a stale snapshot. `allowPlaintextGatewayHop` is an explicit
acknowledgement of the unencrypted hop described below; without it every
Substrate run is refused, and it is only safe on a CNI that enforces
NetworkPolicy. Every setting is described in
[the design note](../design/substrate-backend.md#chart-values).
